name: RT best saved checkpoint within 3000 updates, selected on independent target validation
validation: same frozen81 surveillance validation videos, each begin/middle/end96; all12 saved checkpoints per arm, all four QPs
selection_score: mean_q(mean_81videos_mean3windows(candidate estimated P R+lambda(q)*w_t*D)/same original model validation mean at q)

tie_break: lowest score; exact ties select earliest saved update
baseline: original pretrained model shown separately; do not silently replace worse fine-tuned models
selection_restrictions: finite full-validation metrics and valid codec only; no old2percent or improvement veto
selection_order: freeze all four selection.json before any new test begins
test: frozen82 videos each3x96/IP32 QP0,21,42,63 reset64 nativeYUV420, original paired I frozen; same official float reconstruction metrics and true streams
checkpoint_comparison: best among12 saved250-step checkpoints, not every optimizer update
post_hoc_disclosure: requested after fixed3000 test results were observed; new checkpoint selection uses only independent validation, no new hyperparameter search
test_reuse: only exact selected model tensor identity with previous step3000 endpoint allows prior full82 result reuse; otherwise new test
metric_exception: preserve undefined MS-SSIM and mark full82 metric invalid; no imputation
